defaults.composition: One main waterside texture fills the foreground and middle ground at a natural standing distance, with the water and fresh green bank softly out of focus behind; the view looks slightly down and across

shots.subject: Fresh moss on a stone at the edge of a brook, a thin film of water flowing past and soft morning light on the dewy tips
shots.motion_elements: the thin film of water flowing past

shots.subject: Young beech leaves on a low branch hanging over clear stream water, pale translucent green with the water sparkling below
shots.motion_elements: the beech leaves fluttering and the sparkling water

shots.subject: A small spray of white blackthorn blossom on a dark twig over a slow stream, warm backlight on the petals and the water glowing softly behind
shots.motion_elements: the blossom stirring and the soft glow on the water

shots.subject: Clear water spilling over a rounded mossy stone in a small woodland cascade, with wet fern fronds on one side and a dark pool below
shots.motion_elements: the water spilling over the stone

shots.subject: Raindrops falling from a hazel twig with fresh green leaves into a still pond, small rings spreading across the surface near the mossy bank
shots.motion_elements: the drops falling and the rings spreading

shots.subject: A cluster of unfurling fern fiddleheads on a mossy stream bank, with clear water flowing over pebbles behind them and young leaves above
shots.motion_elements: the fiddleheads stirring and the water flowing

shots.subject: Bright watercress leaves at the edge of a clear spring pool, with water welling up through pale gravel and a strip of mossy bank
shots.motion_elements: the water welling up through the gravel

shots.subject: Soft yellow willow catkins on a slender branch leaning over a stream, warm low light on the catkins and the water glinting behind
Glossy marsh marigold leaves and yellow blooms at the water's edge, young reed shoots beside them and the calm pond surface beyond
shots.motion_elements: the leaves moving and the soft ripples on the pond

shots.subject: A clump of wet pale primroses on a mossy stream bank, with clear water rushing over brown stones just behind them
shots.motion_elements: the water rushing over the stones

shots.subject: A tuft of young green sedges standing in shallow pond water, their reflections below and a thin morning mist on the surface behind
shots.motion_elements: the sedges swaying and the thin mist

shots.subject: Clear water rippling over smooth brown and grey pebbles in a shallow stream, with fresh grass and a few buttercups along the edge
shots.motion_elements: the water rippling over the pebbles

shots.subject: Pale pink cherry blossom petals floating on a quiet stream eddy beside a mossy stone, warm light on the water and the grassy bank
shots.motion_elements: the petals drifting in the eddy

shots.subject: A small trickle of water running down a mossy rock face into a woodland pool, with delicate wood sorrel leaves around it
shots.motion_elements: the trickle running down the rock

shots.subject: Wet young hawthorn leaves and clusters of white blossom on a branch over a brook, drops on the petals and the water flowing beneath
shots.motion_elements: the blossom swaying and the flowing water

shots.subject: Small round lily pads just opening on still pond water, dew beads on their edges and a few young reed shoots rising between them
shots.motion_elements: the floating pads moving slightly on the water
